summary: Describes a way to broadcast IP data one-way using the vertical blanking interval of television signals, the hidden gap between video frames. It is a standards-track document at the proposed standard level.

eli5.summary: TV pictures have a tiny invisible pause between frames. This hides computer data in that pause so a TV signal can carry it too.

questions: how to send ip data over tv signal
what is the vertical blanking interval used for in ip
